h1: Custom UV Sanitizers for Safer Workplaces
metaDescription: Order custom UV sanitizers for your business. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround, and full-color decoration. Perfect for offices, events, and safety programs.
introHtml:
If you're a safety manager or HR director looking to reinforce hygiene protocols, custom UV sanitizers offer a practical, visible solution. These devices use ultraviolet light to kill germs on phones, keys, and other small items, giving employees and visitors a quick way to sanitize high-touch surfaces. Marketing directors can also use them as branded giveaways that show your company prioritizes health. With options like the Pooch Pack or the Credit Card Shaped Hand Sanitizer Sprayer, you can choose a format that fits your environment.

Perfect Imprints stocks a range of UV sanitizers and complementary hand sanitizer products, including gel packets, sprays, and combos like the 2 in 1 Sanitizer and Pen. Each item can be customized with your logo using screen printing, pad printing, or full-color heat transfer. Whether you need a small run for a trade show or a bulk order for employee onboarding, we help you find the right balance of cost and impact. Browse our selection below to see what fits your program.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom UV sanitizers, focus on the device's effectiveness and ease of use. Look for models that specify UV-C wavelength (typically 254 nm) and have a built-in timer or auto-shutoff. The Pooch Pack, for example, is a portable pouch that can sanitize small items in seconds. For stationary use, consider units that can hold phones or tablets. Verify that the sanitizer is tested for germicidal efficacy, especially if you're distributing to healthcare or food service clients.

Materials and build quality matter for durability. Most UV sanitizers are made of ABS plastic or silicone. Silicone options like the Pooch Pack are flexible and easy to clean, while hard plastic models offer more protection. If you're ordering for outdoor events or high-traffic areas, choose a model with a sealed battery compartment and water-resistant construction. For hand sanitizers in gel or spray form, check that the container is leak-proof and made from BPA-free materials.

Common use cases for custom UV sanitizers include corporate offices, trade show booths, employee break rooms, and customer waiting areas. Safety managers often use them as part of a broader hygiene kit, while HR directors may include them in onboarding packets. For promotional events, branded UV sanitizers are a conversation starter that reinforces your commitment to health. The Outdoor 5-Piece Wellness Set combines UV sanitizer with other hygiene items, making it ideal for field teams or conference swag.

Decoration and Customization Options

Most UV sanitizers can be decorated with your logo via pad printing, screen printing, or full-color heat transfer. The Credit Card Shaped Hand Sanitizer Sprayer offers a flat surface ideal for full-color branding. For hand sanitizer packets like the Sanitizer Gel Packet, flexographic printing is common. Always request a decoration proof before production to ensure colors match your brand guidelines. Some items, like the 1 oz Sanitizer in Trapezoid Bottle w/ Sleeve, allow for a printed sleeve that can be swapped out for different campaigns.

Quantity and MOQ considerations: UV sanitizers typically have higher MOQs (often 500-1000 units) due to the electronics involved. Hand sanitizer packets and sprays have lower MOQs (as low as 100-250). Bulk orders reduce per-unit costs significantly, so plan your budget accordingly. If you need a small test run, consider ordering a few dozen of a lower-MOQ item like the 0.5 oz Li'l Cleaner Hand Sanitizer before committing to a large UV device order. Lead times for UV sanitizers are usually 10-15 business days, while simple screen-printed packets can ship in 5-7 days.

A common mistake is overlooking battery type and replacement. Some UV sanitizers use disposable batteries, while others have rechargeable lithium-ion cells. If you're ordering for a long-term program, rechargeable models save costs over time. Also, check the size of the sanitizing chamber — it must fit the intended items (e.g., phones, keys, pens). For hand sanitizers, avoid ordering large quantities of gel if your climate is hot, as gel can degrade. Always request a sample of decorated product to verify quality before full production.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom UV sanitizers?
faqs.a: Most UV sanitizers have an MOQ of 500-1000 units due to the electronics. Hand sanitizer packets and sprays often have lower MOQs starting at 100-250 units. Contact us for specific product MOQs.

faqs.q: How are logos applied to UV sanitizers?
faqs.a: Logos can be pad printed, screen printed, or applied via full-color heat transfer. The Credit Card Shaped Hand Sanitizer Sprayer is ideal for full-color branding. We provide a digital proof before production.

faqs.q: What is the typical lead time for custom UV sanitizers?
faqs.a: Custom UV sanitizers usually ship within 10-15 business days after proof approval. Simpler items like printed hand sanitizer packets can ship in 5-7 business days. Rush orders may be available.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer samples of blank or decorated products. Sample fees apply but are often credited toward your bulk order. Contact your account manager to request a sample.

faqs.q: Are UV sanitizers safe for all devices?
faqs.a: UV-C sanitizers are safe for most hard, non-porous surfaces like phones, keys, and pens. Avoid using on delicate items like camera lenses or leather. Always check the manufacturer's instructions.
